Well, the diameter of this hose is slighly smaller than the one that was previously on the washer - thus slowing down the water flow as it drains. The 2 back rollers, WD12X10267, are narrower and once the center of the wheel and/or the axle wear, they wobble and fall off the track. The wider front rollers each take less load (because there are 4 of them) and don't so readily fall off the track both because they wear less and aren't so narrow.

To stop the back of the rack falling off the track, I moved 2 of the front wheels (WD12X271) to the back and they worked fine.
